offering_description.value: Distributes cloud software, licenses and related technology from software publishers to IT solution providers, resellers and managed service providers. Provides cloud billing, provisioning and support so partners can resell products to businesses and earn margin on each sale.

primary_products.value: cloud software licenses; security software; collaboration software; hardware

primary_services.value: cloud billing and provisioning; technical support and training; professional services

customer_segment.value: B2B: IT solution providers, value-added resellers, managed service providers

end_markets.value: IT channel; cloud software; cybersecurity; collaboration

revenue_model.value: product sales: software licenses and hardware resold to channel partners; service fees: cloud management, billing and support fees charged to partners

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys from software publishers and sells to IT solution providers and resellers

specialization.value: niche specialist: cloud and software distribution, with no separate businesses

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: IT solution providers and managed service providers; online: cloud marketplace and online ordering portal for partners

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, some export and data privacy rules apply to resold technology

notes: Geographic coverage and size judgment are based on general knowledge and may be incomplete.
